root_cause: Latest immutable production observation correctly used SOURCE_DEPLOYED_AUTHENTICATED_ADMIN_READBACK_DUE and PUBLISHED_SOURCE_VERIFIED_BROWSER_READBACK_DUE, but the original server allowlist only recognized historical LIVE_SOURCE_AND_BROWSER_PROVEN and the client conflated an earlier browser run with a fresh authenticated administrator card readback.
fix: Server allowlists exact newest provider-source-deployed statuses; client separately compares provider published SHA, and renders pending authenticated admin readback amber, not generic unknown or false green.
prevention_rules: Before accepting new immutable observed-state status, enumerate exact supported values in the same original server allowlist and UI reducer; fail closed for unknown strings.
Historical browser PASS and a deployed SHA never certify a new authenticated administrator view or 2-tenant proof.
Regression uses the actual most recent provider observation fields plus unknown/adversarial status replay.
Keep incident register and source/current provider timelines independent, no secret or raw incident payload in client.
owner: original Portal V2 and ONE BRAIN production status owner
terminal_rule: Do not claim complete success before protected exact-head merge, Netlify published SHA, authenticated original admin browser readback and fresh contract tests.
